title: The Orchard of the Palatinate
author: Yara Zhou
blurb: Hazel Ravensworth, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
